title: T4 — cold plate with fins
request: A liquid cold plate: a 60 mm x 40 mm x 8 mm aluminium block with a serpentine channel milled through it, 4 mm wide and 5 mm deep, making three passes across the plate with 3 mm of metal between passes. Mesh the water side only. Inlet and outlet are the two open ends of the channel.
properties: channel width 4 mm and depth 5 mm, measured at more than one station
wall thickness between passes, 3 mm — **measured, as the minimum over the solid**
minimum local width of the fluid domain
